strings.en: Additional special types: neurogenic rosacea, granulomatous rosacea, steroid-induced rosacea (after prolonged improper use of potent corticosteroids).

strings.zh: 「糟」字暗示「污穢」，進一步加深污名化
降低患者就醫的心理障礙
strings.en: Reduces psychological barriers to seeking care

strings.zh: 共軛焦顯微鏡(Confocal microscopy)：醫學中心研究使用，門診少見。
strings.en: Reflectance confocal microscopy (RCM): used in academic research; uncommon in routine clinics.

strings.zh: 原為疥瘡治療藥，對蟎蟲有效
strings.en: Originally a scabies treatment; effective against mites

strings.zh: 每週 2-3 次薄擦於整臉，共 6-8 週
strings.en: Apply thinly to entire face 2–3 times per week for 6–8 weeks

strings.zh: 價格較低，但較刺激，效果不如 Ivermectin
strings.en: Lower cost but more irritating; less effective than ivermectin

strings.zh: 健保有給付（疥瘡適應症）
每天 2 次，可長期使用
strings.en: Twice daily; suitable for long-term use

strings.zh: 主要抗發炎，對蟎蟲影響有限
strings.en: Primarily anti-inflammatory; limited effect on mites

strings.zh: 頑固性蟎蟲性玫瑰斑、嚴重型可考慮
strings.en: Consider for refractory Demodex-associated or severe rosacea

strings.zh: 0.2-0.4 mg/kg 單次或分 2 次間隔 1-2 週服用
strings.en: 0.2–0.4 mg/kg as a single dose, or split into 2 doses 1–2 weeks apart

strings.zh: 需專科評估，健保不給付此適應症
strings.en: Specialist evaluation required; NHI does not cover this indication

strings.zh: 禁忌：孕婦、體重 < 15kg 兒童
「酒糟」這個名稱已被臺灣皮膚科醫學會 2022 共識正名為「玫瑰斑」
strings.en: The name 「酒糟」 was officially renamed 「玫瑰斑」 (rosacea) by the TDA 2022 consensus

strings.zh: 蠕形蟎蟲關鍵研究結論
同時改善蟎蟲密度與發炎症狀
strings.en: concurrently improves both mite density and inflammation

strings.zh: 處置蟎蟲確實能改善病灶
標準化皮膚表面切片(Standardized Skin Surface Biopsy, SSSB)
2022 德國 S2k 指引 ↑↑ 強推薦
strings.en: Strongly recommended by 2022 German S2k guidelines

strings.zh: Schaller 2020 重度玫瑰斑組合療法
肉毒桿菌素 微注射
不要用洗臉海綿或清潔刷
strings.en: Do not use facial sponges or cleansing brushes

strings.zh: 神經醯胺、菸鹼醯胺、玻尿酸、積雪草
strings.en: Ceramides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, Centella asiatica

strings.zh: 果酸、水楊酸、A 酸、薄荷、椰子油
strings.en: AHAs, salicylic acid, retinoids, menthol, coconut oil

strings.zh: 停止「主動治療」後維持「保養治療」
strings.en: Transition from active treatment to maintenance therapy after clearance

strings.zh: 多因素的慢性發炎疾病
外用 Ivermectin 是丘疹膿皰型玫瑰斑近年的治療突破
strings.en: Topical ivermectin is a recent breakthrough for papulopustular rosacea

strings.zh: 應至皮膚科鑑別玫瑰斑
strings.en: Seek dermatology evaluation to confirm rosacea

strings.zh: TDA 正名後的完整處置共識
strings.en: Comprehensive management consensus following TDA renaming

strings.zh: 對熱、辣、酒精的血管反應過度，潮紅、灼熱
strings.en: Exaggerated vascular response to heat, spicy food, and alcohol; flushing and burning

strings.zh: TLR2 受體 / Cathelicidin (LL-37) 路徑活化
皮脂組成改變，提供蟎蟲增殖溫床
strings.en: Altered sebum composition creates a niche for mite proliferation
UV, heat, spicy food, alcohol, stress

strings.zh: 反覆潮紅、持續性紅斑、微血管擴張
類似痘痘的紅色丘疹 + 膿皰，不像痘痘那樣有粉刺
strings.en: Acne-like red papules + pustules, but without comedones unlike acne

strings.zh: 鼻部組織增厚、皮脂腺肥大
strings.en: Nasal tissue thickening and sebaceous-gland hypertrophy

strings.zh: 眼乾、灼熱、眼瞼炎、結膜炎
α2 腎上腺素受體致效劑
暫時減潮紅（藥效 8-12 小時），不治根本
strings.en: Temporarily reduces flushing (8–12 h duration); does not address underlying cause

strings.zh: 頑固性潮紅、神經性玫瑰斑
頑固性潮紅、皮膚潮紅 — TDA 2022 新增治療選項
strings.en: Refractory flushing — newly included in TDA 2022 treatment options

strings.zh: 頑固性、肉芽腫型、鼻瘤型早期
strings.en: Refractory, granulomatous, or early phymatous types

strings.zh: 脈衝染料雷射 PDL、強脈衝光 IPL、Nd:YAG
strings.en: Pulsed-dye laser (PDL), intense pulsed light (IPL), Nd:YAG
